description: PM-posture skill that opens the next 宿場 Shukuba station for a project — the model writes the station for the next unticked item on the active seed's route, in the shukuba template's shape, and a script decides whether that station may be opened before it lands at the shukuba root in one commit. A station of that seed parked for that item is taken up again instead, its reached-when unchanged. Halts outside a pm session or the pm subagent. Use when a project has an active seed and no open station — "open the next station", "open the shukuba", "start the next leg", "shukuba-open". Do not use for picking or un-picking a seed (nemawashi-pick, nemawashi-unpick), cutting or re-cutting the route (stations-from-seed, shukuba-refine), opening a change unit (tobiishi-open), closing or parking a station (shukuba-retire, shukuba-park), or the instance router under system/shukuba/.
